description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountTransactionDataValidator' provides validation logic for savings account transactions, including transaction date validation, transaction data validation, activation, closing, hold, and release operations within the Fineract microfinance platform.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for savings account transactions, handling validation for transaction data, activation, closing, hold, and release operations.

methods.name: validateTransactionWithPivotDate
methods.description: Validates if a transaction date is allowed considering pivot date configurations and interest posting date.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates transaction data including date, amount, and payment type.

methods.name: validateActivation
methods.description: Validates activation request data for a savings account.

methods.name: validateClosing
methods.description: Validates closing request data for a savings account, including date, balance, and account status.

methods.name: validatePaymentTypeDetails
methods.description: Validates payment type related details such as account number, check number, routing code, etc.

methods.name: validateHoldAndAssembleForm
methods.description: Validates hold amount form data for a savings account, including amount, reason, and date.

methods.name: validateReleaseAmountAndAssembleForm
methods.description: Validates and processes release of hold amount transaction.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws exception if validation errors are present.
